dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt software (JMA standard receipt software), compiled with GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL on Linux. Program ORCGW13 handles system management information settings for disaster/injury medical billing.

purpose.domain_detail: JMA ORCA Japanese medical receipt (shinryo-hoshu) billing system — system management information settings screen (W13), handling disaster/injury classification, tax classification, point unit prices, and related billing parameters for medical institutions.
purpose.summary: ORCGW13 is a screen-based batch/online program within the JMA ORCA medical receipt system that manages system configuration settings for medical billing, including injury/disaster classification codes, tax categories, point unit prices, and related parameters. It uses extensive COPY books for shared SPA (screen parameter area) structures and enumerated values. The program handles display, input validation, and registration of these settings.

notable_features: 69 COPY statements indicating heavy use of shared copybooks
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS
Japanese EUC/Shift-JIS encoded comments (latin-1 decoded with mojibake)
SPA (Screen Parameter Area) pattern typical of ORCA system
Fixed-format source with max line length 74
verdict.notes: Comments are encoded in Japanese (EUC-JP or Shift-JIS) but decoded as latin-1, resulting in mojibake in the visible text. The program is clearly part of the well-known open-source JMA ORCA medical receipt system.
